summary: 1941 federal survey and a 1949 newspaper describe a steel lookout near Olla slated to move and rise to 130 ft; heights and site disagree; current status not found.

facts.design: all-steel lookout tower with an enclosed cabin at the top

events.note: First observed by the Coast and Geodetic Survey; described as a lookout tower of the Louisiana Conservation Department about 1 mile SW of Olla, about 90 feet high.

Newspaper says the tower stood 100 feet high, was to be moved to a new location and raised to 130 feet, and would have radio and telephone. The move is described as planned; no other source found confirms it.
Listed in a Louisiana lookout tower list revised May 2011 under 'olla' with the NGS datasheet BX2564; the list gives coordinates only.

corrections.why: 11N is the township part of the survey location (T. 11 N., R. 2 E.), not an agency. The 1941 survey names the Louisiana Conservation Department as the operator; the later operator is not confirmed by a source.

The NGS station's NAD 83 position is 31 53 48.18665 N, 092 15 28.82294 W (about 31.8968, -92.2580), and the 2011 tower list gives 31.89672, -92.25801. The brief point is about 1.6 km southeast of the station. It may be a town-centre point rather than the tower, so the editor should decide.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1941 survey says about 90 feet and the 1949 newspaper says 100 feet at the time, with 130 feet planned after a move. No height_m fact is set because the sources disagree; the story gives both figures.
The 1941 survey places the station in section 34; the Central Louisiana Lookouts page gives section 35. The story reports both and does not choose one.

sources.title: Louisiana lookout towers (tower list, revised May 2011)

notes_for_editor: Current status unknown. The Olla Wikipedia article, the NHLR Louisiana list (7 towers, none here) and the cached Wikipedia tower list do not mention this tower. The 1949 article is only quoted on the Central Louisiana Lookouts page; the original Olla-Tullos Signal (1936-1969, digitized at loc.gov/item/sn88064066) may cover the move or later years and was not searched. The 'Louisiana Conservation Department' label is the 1941 name only; the agency that ran the tower later is unknown. The brief's agency value '11N' and its coordinates are the two proposed corrections.
